title: japanese-rag-kotlin
description: On-device Japanese retrieval-augmented generation for Android and JVM in Kotlin: a pure-Kotlin core (ruri-v3 Unigram tokenizer that matches Hugging Face output, Japanese sentence chunker, in-memory vector index, retrieve-then-rerank pipeline) and an Android module running LiteRT conversions of ruri-v3 and Japanese rerankers.
